design.module: services/source_ingestion/snapshot_universe.py (SnapshotUniverse); reuses UniverseTier, UniverseTransition, GOVERNED_ACTIVE_TW_PAPER_PERSONAS, SOURCE_INGEST_ACTIVE_PAPER_SYMBOLS from active_universe.py
design.activation: Opt-in and fail-safe: until POST /api/source-ingest/snapshots/universe/sweep creates the membership state file (<journal>.universe.json) the projection behaves exactly as today (all symbols admitted, journal_stats.snapshot_universe.state=missing, reason=membership_state_missing). Existing tests rely on the all-symbol projection, so default-on was rejected.
design.write_path: LatestMarketSnapshotStore.admission hook filters the daily projection only; MarketDataStorageWriter and pipeline.py are untouched, so governed partitions are unchanged.
design.read_path: GET /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest (daily) -> SnapshotUniverse.snapshot_for_request: member hit refreshes last_requested_date; non-member is seeded from raw/*/tw_price_daily/date=*/ partitions through LatestMarketSnapshotStore._point_from_record and append_normalized_records (same merge path, per-record ingest_run_id from the partition file name, connector market via manager), observed_at = newest partition mtime.
design.removal: withdraw_symbols appends the existing withdrawal tombstone (journal line encoding unchanged, deployed reader already understands it, no rollback ordering). UniverseTransition(candidate->archive) is recorded in the state file.
design.trading_day_measure: weekdays (no exchange calendar in the repo); a holiday makes a member expire at most a few calendar days later than 10 exchange sessions never earlier than 10 weekdays.
design.operator_step: After deploy the operator acceptance task must call POST /api/source-ingest/snapshots/universe/sweep once to adopt membership and shrink the journal; compaction then removes the tombstoned keys.

acceptance_proof.1_partitions_unchanged: test_partitions_identical_and_projection_only_keeps_members (byte equal store tree with and without universe)
acceptance_proof.3_byte_identity: test_first_request_seeds_byte_identical_snapshot_within_two_seconds (60 points incl. provisional collector_close points; to_public_dict JSON equals all-symbol projection)
acceptance_proof.7_always_members: test_governed_and_env_symbols_are_always_members (2330/0050/2317 governed personas used by hosted_lifecycle_probe, agora readiness and persona runtimes; env symbols); sweep seeds them if absent
acceptance_proof.9_suite: scripts/ci_source_ingestion_test_shards.py --shards 4 --max-test-seconds 300: ran 2153 (skipped 22) of 2153 collected, all shards exit 0; new tests ~3 s total

measurement_8_real_shaped_journal_local_.shape: 1,501 symbols x 60 daily points, collector_close lineage on the last 10 points, written by the real pipeline/writer; 3 governed statics absent from partitions
measurement_8_real_shaped_journal_local_.note: Only the single requested symbol is re-seeded on demand (60 points, one journal line ~71 KB). Hosted 17,430 keys / 466 MB / 6.6 GiB RSS must be measured by the operator acceptance task; resident bytes here are process RSS dominated by the Python/test harness, so the per-key projection is the meaningful figure (about 47.7 KB per key before).
